Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 23

“Weapons do not cut it, fire does not burn it, water does not wet it, and wind does not wither it.”

Four elements, four failures. Krishna runs through the battlefield's own instruments of destruction and finds each one irrelevant — which lands differently when spoken between two armed armies.
